title: Physics-source-1 closed receipt and physical evidence; semantic invariants require executable validation

charged.description: Known metered/reserved work; excludes the separate reserved_unobserved_failure amount.

reserved_unobserved_failure.description: Additional conservative reservation for failure work without a returned meter. It is not included in charged and is debited exactly once. Current fully metered implementation emits zero.

work.description: PHYSICS-SOURCE-1 implementation policy: at most 8,000,000 reservations per case, with charged plus reserved-unobserved failure work summed across the invocation at most 64,000,000. SOURCE-BLOCKS-1 remains at 4,000,000 per case; generic and strict-gap helper limits are separate.
